cs.t: > You're supposed to rinse things before putting them into the dish washer. I think this is a popular misconception from many people's experience with bad dishwasher soaps.  With high quality detergent and rinse solution I never pre-wash dishes and they virtually always come out clean.  I use the Cascade Complete brand which is definitely on the more expensive side, maybe the most expensive, but it's still very cheap accounting for the amount of time in your life it saves from never hand-washing dishes.  I also use their rinse aid which makes a big difference too.
